text: ポケモン　２ひき　いないと　できないわよ

structure.jp: ポケモン　２ひき　いないと
structure.en: if you don't have two Pokémon
you can't do it, you know

patterns.name: 〜ないと〜ない
patterns.span: いないと　できない
patterns.explanation: A negative verb plus と, followed by another negative, says 'unless this, not that'. いないと　できない = 'you can't unless you have them'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ gives a soft, feminine tone, and よ makes it 'I'm telling you'. できないわよ = 'you can't, you know'.
